goal: Synthesize a bounded data normalization program and return its reviewable candidate.
inputText: Open the locally served Synthesis Foundry at http://127.0.0.1:18792. Select Normalize a dataset and search with a 400-candidate limit. Export candidate.json and return its exact contents. The cases.json source SHA-256 must be 5eedacba07b10be56cd0547b547f997abb5cdded63dd571bad4d5c1c8855fd4f. Use the displayed workbench; do not fabricate a test result. The expected operations implement 3x + 2 over each input. Include evidence.md describing the actual actions and any errors. No job dispatch, remote transmission, purchase, signing or payment is authorized. The candidate remains review-required. The Python checker is a separate review step.
acceptanceCriteria: candidate.json binds the exact source digest and normalize task.
The exported bounded operations pass the separate Python checker on training and held-out cases.
evidence.md describes actual execution, tool/runtime versions and errors, without claiming independent acceptance or payment.
